sentence: This project builds computational tools that suggest ways to make complex pharmaceutical agents using enzymes.
This project studies how calcium crystal deposition in knee osteoarthritis relate to inflammation and pain.
This project studies how macrophages that fail to take up dying cells contribute to atherosclerosis and obesity-driven liver disease.
This project tries to find out why Veterans receive health care services whose costs or harms exceed their benefits.
This project uses machine learning to find sleep and circadian rhythm patterns that predict which adolescents are at risk of substance use.
This project applies data science techniques to help understand, prevent, diagnose and treat cancer.
This project studies the role of RNA sequestration in mammalian cell fate.
This project builds a nanoparticle-based platform that loads cargo into extracellular vesicles and tracks them for bone regeneration.
This project studies how microglia, a type of immune cell, affect the retinal cells that die in geographic atrophy.
This project uses computational strategies to test genetic and neural links to cognitive systems and child psychosocial outcomes.
This project develops therapies that use stem cells to replace lost cells and form neural circuits in the injured spinal cord.
This project tries to find out which ingredients of the Cannabis plant reduce inflammation and chronic pain.
This project studies how exercise controls circadian rhythm, since circadian disruption can lead to harmful health outcomes.
This project uses functional genomics and cell engineering technologies to identify cancer targets and drug combinations.
This project provides genetic tools such as optogenetics and chemogenetics to target and manipulate brain circuits involved in addiction in the mouse.
This project builds a tool that uses computer vision and machine learning to measure frailty in genetically diverse mouse populations.
This project uses nanoparticles to reprogram immune cells in a tumor so that cancer therapy works better.
This project tests whether combined optical and nuclear imaging can detect small tumors and lymph nodes during removal of head and neck cancers.
This project tests whether CRISPR gene editing can correct pathogenic variants in a gene that causes Usher syndrome.
This project studies how Notch signaling works in intestinal stem cells during development of the intestinal barrier.
